title.romaji: Disney Twisted-Wonderland: THE ANIMATION - Season 1: EPISODE of HEARTSLABYUL
title.native: ディズニー ツイステッドワンダーランド ザ アニメーション シーズン1「エピソード オブ ハーツラビュル」

synonyms: ディズニー ツイステッドワンダーランド
ดิสนีย์: ทวิสเต็ดวันเดอร์แลนด์
description:
Yuuken is whisked away to Night Raven College, an arcane academy in the world of Twisted Wonderland. Stranded until he can find a way home, Yuuken is allowed to stay on campus despite having no magic of his own. But when his new friends land him in trouble with the headmage, his future at the school looks bleak. Now Yuuken’s fate hinges on bringing together a pair of argumentative first-years and a fire-breathing monster cat…

(Source: VIZ Media, edited)

name.native: リドル・ローズハート

node.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm
__Dorm:__ 2nd Year Housewarden of Heartslabyul

He has a strict personality and prioritizes rules and regulations above all else. He is feared for meting out the merciless punishment known as "Off with Your Head!" to anyone who violates his dormitory's rules, yet—contrary to the impression this gives—he is actually quite expressive.

Although he is a strict individual, his actions are motivated by a desire to improve the dormitory; he is not a bad person at heart, and his usual demeanor is calm (in fact, not a single student has dropped out since he became dorm leader).

While he usually leads Heartslabyul with a firm and dignified attitude, he often finds himself being swept up by the antics of those around him. He has a low tolerance for provocation and a quick temper; when angry, his face turns bright red and he lets out a strange, high-pitched shriek of "Ugh-iiiii!!"

He is childhood friends with [Trey](https://anilist.co/character/195309/Trey-Clover), who belongs to the same dormitory. He also has a childhood friend, [Chenya](https://anilist.co/character/199056/Alchemi-Alchemivich-Pinka), who attends the rival school, Royal Sword Academy.

name.native: マレウス・ドラコニア

node.description:
__Height:__ 202 cm (including horns)
__Dorm:__ 3rd Year Housewarden of Diasomnia

A descendant of the fae dragon lineage, he possesses black horns and pointed ears. As the heir to the throne of the Valley of Thorns, he enrolled at the school to broaden his horizons. Back home, he rarely ventured outside and required an escort just to step a single foot out of the castle—a restriction seemingly influenced by the Council of Elders. Given his high status, his birthday is a national holiday in his homeland; he reportedly found the day exhausting, as he was dragged from one ceremony to another from morning till night.

He speaks in an imperious tone but generally projects a calm and composed demeanor. He possesses a magnanimous nature, willing to tolerate—and forgive. He does crack jokes (though they are rarely recognized as such) and occasionally smiles; he treats those who show no malice—even strangers who are simply polite—with warmth and friendliness. However, it is said that when he gets angry, he often unleashes lightning.

His hobby is exploring ruins. He has been spotted several times at the dilapidated dormitory where the protagonist lives; this may be because it is quiet and hard for his attendants to locate, but also because the building itself is practically a ruin. He is also fond of gargoyles and sometimes tours the campus to look at them.

He has a particular fascination with dragons and other similar mythical creatures, often speaking at great length when discussing them ([Kalim](https://anilist.co/character/199059/Kalim-Al-Asim) describes this as being "like a fast-talking [Idia](https://anilist.co/character/199057/Idia-Shroud)"—a comparison Idia himself does not deny). Incidentally, he keeps a stone dragon statue in his dormitory room. As a dragon fairy, he is capable of breathing fire. He also possesses unfathomable magical power

__Height:__ 183 cm
__Dorm:__ 3rd Year Housewarden of Ignihyde

The older of the Shroud brothers, a duo considered one of NRC's "Seven Mysteries."

A genius, a shut-in, an "arrogant" otaku, and an unintentionally handsome guy from a prestigious family who harbors a dark side—a man officially described as having the traits of a light novel protagonist. Whether for classes or school events, he generally participates remotely—either communicating via his self-made floating tablet or leaving everything to [Ortho](https://anilist.co/character/199054/Ortho-Shroud) to handle. He naturally uses his tablet device even for face-to-face conversations. Notably, he is the only student at the academy permitted to attend classes remotely. He has a limited social circle; aside from [Azul](https://anilist.co/character/195637/Azul-Ashengrotto) (a fellow Board Game Club member) and the Housewardens and Vice Housewardens, he has very few acquaintances.

When encountering people he dislikes or terrifying situations, he lets out strange cries like "Hii!" "Eek!" or "Help me!" while clutching his hands in front of his chest—sometimes even tearing up. However, when faced with a genuine emergency, he utilizes his brilliant mind to calmly assess and handle the situation.

Whether in person or online, if the conversation turns to a topic he is interested in, he comes alive—like a fish in water—and begins speaking enthusiastically, peppering his speech with old-school internet slang. He is harsh toward those who don't understand otaku culture, often muttering, "This is exactly why 'normies' are..." However, if he recognizes someone as a kindred spirit, he is easily won over—to the point where he might end up dancing the night away with a Vice Housewarden from another dorm he barely knows.

As part of his fandom activities, he proactively spreads the word about their music whenever possible and even visits the real-world locations that served as settings for their works.

~!While he is a self-proclaimed and widely acknowledged gloomy loner, there are hints suggesting he was naturally cheerful and lively in the past.!~

name.native: リリア・ヴァンルージュ

node.description:
__Height:__ 158 cm
__Dorm:__ 3rd Year Vice Housewarden of Diasomnia

He is a bat fae who appears to be a small boy—though he speaks in a somewhat old-fashioned manner. "Vanrouge" is technically an epithet rather than a surname. 

He was responsible for [Malleus's](https://anilist.co/character/199053/Malleus-Draconia) upbringing in their homeland, the Valley of Thorns. [Silver](https://anilist.co/character/199060/Silver) calls him "Father," and Lilia has raised him since he was an infant.

The birthday listed in his profile appears to be merely the date he registered upon entering Night Raven College; he reportedly forgot his actual birthday somewhere along the way during his long life.

He is quite sociable and appears in numerous episodes involving students from other dorms. He seems to be a caring figure; whenever he spots someone in trouble, he strikes up a conversation and offers assistance.

His singing voice is also beyond imagination; at the previous year's Light Music Club recruitment event, he belted out shouts in a raspy voice that horrified the prospective members (he even stage-dived into the crowd, only to be slammed onto the floor when no one caught him), and he reportedly sang lullabies with that same shouting style (only [Kalim](https://anilist.co/character/199059/Kalim-Al-Asim) ended up joining the club as a result). It’s not that he’s tone-deaf, he seems capable of singing properly if he puts his mind to it. It’s just that his sense of style is completely off the wall.

name.native: レオナ・キングスカラー

node.description:
__Height:__ 185 cm
__Dorm:__ 3rd Year Housewarden of Savanaclaw

Despite possessing immense magical power, he dislikes making an effort and maintains a perpetually languid attitude.

He sometimes skips class to take naps, leading [Ruggie](https://anilist.co/character/195429/Ruggie-Bucchi) to worry that he might be held back a year—again. His age might lead to misunderstandings, but he has actually only repeated one year, not two; this is because he enrolled at Night Raven College a year late.

Surprisingly, his hobby is chess. As chess is a board game often described as a "mental sport," this reveals that he possesses high intellectual capabilities, contrary to his usual demeanor. He also possesses great athletic ability; during Flight Lessons, he stands on his broomstick and catches birds with nonchalant ease.

~!In his home country (the "Sunset Savanna"), he was constantly compared to his older brother—the first prince—and, as the second prince with no hope of ascending the throne, he often adopts a cynical, world-weary attitude. However, one must admit that his personality played a role in those comparisons, making the situation largely of his own making. Specifically, he brazenly skips important ceremonies, utters nothing but sarcasm even at celebratory events, and is arrogant and full of pride. He loathes effort and, while he does make plans, he is a master at shifting blame—insisting that if things go wrong, it is everyone else's fault.!~

He is also one of the few people who can speak to [Malleus](https://anilist.co/character/199053/Malleus-Draconia) without fear—even going so far as to get into verbal sparring matches with him.

__Height:__ 172 cm
__Dorm:__ 1st Year Student of Heartslabyul. 

He has a fearless personality, speaking his mind openly and cheerfully—sometimes even disrupting the atmosphere of a situation. While his outward demeanor is casual, he is actually a pragmatist who views things realistically; in the story, he often counters others' arguments with sound, logical reasoning. 

His dislike for indecisiveness likely stems from his own nature of making quick, firm decisions. 

He is shrewd—for better or worse—and often arrives at conclusions or insights ahead of his fellow dorm mate, [Deuce](https://anilist.co/character/195304/Spade-Deuce). He is quick-witted and articulate enough to hold long conversations even with older people he has just met. He is dexterous and handles tasks competently, but his lack of enthusiasm often leads him to do things half-heartedly; he tends to take the easy way out and can be sloppy when it comes to the final details. Furthermore, whenever he tries to exploit his own cleverness for the wrong reasons, he almost invariably faces some form of comeuppance.

Due to his pragmatic mindset and lack of passion, he makes quick judgments—a trait that cuts both ways. In a positive light, he can view situations objectively and take appropriate action; in a negative light, he avoids risk and effort to such an extent that he shies away from challenges that would push his limits, gives up easily, and can be seen as timid.

He has no particular dream for the future and tends to look down on getting fired up or earnestly dedicating oneself to something, though he apparently still harbors a desire to defeat the dorm leader.

__Height:__ 173 cm
__Dorm:__ 1st Year Student of Heartslabyul

He enrolled in the academy with the intention of becoming a fine mage and leading a serious student life... or so he thought.

Shortly after enrolling, however, he was dragged into a squabble between [Ace](https://anilist.co/character/195302/Ace-Trappola) and [Grim](https://anilist.co/character/195303/Grim); consequently, he found himself scrambling alongside the others to avoid expulsion. As fellow first-years, they often stick together within the academy grounds.

He is surprised to find that, despite the school's prestigious reputation, it is home to quite a few troublemakers.

~!He went through a rebellious phase in the past, and traces of that time sometimes resurface when his emotions run high. He attributes this past behavior to a time when he was clumsy and saw no results from their efforts, leading him to give up and take the easy way out. His past antics included addressing teachers without honorifics, hanging out with a bad crowd, bleaching his hair, and tearing up mountain passes on a Magical Wheel—behavior that Grim described as being "a textbook delinquent the likes of which you rarely see these days." He considers this a dark chapter of his life he would rather keep hidden.

The reason he turned over a new leaf and resolved to change his ways was witnessing his mother tearfully consulting his grandmother over the phone. He is devoted to his mother and used to help out with household chores, such as cooking and carrying groceries.!~

__Height:__ 191 cm
__Dorm:__ 2nd Year Student of Octavinelle

Although he is [Jade's](https://anilist.co/character/195638/Jade-Leech) twin brother, his tone of voice and facial expressions differ significantly. 

He is highly mercurial and elusive, making his actions unpredictable. Whether attending class, working at the Mostro Lounge, or messing with others, his behavior is driven entirely by his mood at the moment; he has a short temper and gets upset easily over things he dislikes (though the reverse is also true, and his mood can suddenly improve over trivial matters). Because of this personality, he is often described as the "dangerous one" of the twins—though, to be fair, Jade’s personality is hardly conventional either.

When he is truly angry, his face goes completely blank. His demeanor is notably laid-back; he often makes tactless remarks or mocks others, yet he can also offer casual praise, showing a straightforward nature—for better or worse. His impulsive and curious nature leads him to do outrageous things, making him appear unintelligent at first glance. However, that impression only applies when he acts without thinking of the consequences; in reality, he is incredibly sharp and quick-witted. When he gets serious, his keen intuition allows him to hit the mark or calmly take the optimal course of action, making him a highly reliable presence.

True to his personality, he gets bored easily. By his own account, he only joined the basketball club because he happened to be in the mood for it that day; depending on his whims, he could just as easily have ended up in a different club, like the Light Music Club. 

He nicknames people based on their appearance or characteristics, using the names of sea creatures or aquatic animals (e.g., calling the [protagonist](https://anilist.co/character/317526) "Little Shrimp" because they jumped in fear; calling [Grim](https://anilist.co/character/195303/Grim) "Little Seal" due to his round physique; and likely referring to [Ace](https://anilist.co/character/195302/Ace-Trappola) and [Deuce](https://anilist.co/character/195304/Deuce-Spade) as "Little Crab" and "Little Mackerel," respectively, based on their hair colors). He assigns nicknames even to teachers, though he makes an exception for Jade and [Azul](https://anilist.co/character/195637/Azul-Ashengrotto), calling them by their actual names (remarking, "Azul is just Azul").

name.native: アズール・アーシェングロット

node.description:
__Height:__ 176 cm
__Dorm:__ 2nd Year Dorm Leader of Octavinelle

He maintains a polite demeanor with everyone. He excels academically but struggles with physical activities; his performance in flight lessons is reportedly among the worst in the class.

In addition to his studies, he runs a café called "Mostro Lounge" within the dormitory. He doesn't just serve food and drinks; he also operates a sort of "fixer" service, accepting requests to handle students' worries or procure items they desire in exchange for payment.

[Jade](https://anilist.co/character/195638/Jade-Leech) and [Floyd](https://anilist.co/character/195647/Floyd-Leech), who act as his sidekicks, have been his friends since childhood (though Floyd claims it took quite a while for him to even recognize him, despite being in the same class). He hails from the Coral Sea, specifically a cold northern region where drift ice forms.

He is a highly calculating, rational, and money-loving individual. He demands payment for any service—even things as simple as helping a student prepare for a test—and is constantly focused on business.

To gain the upper hand in negotiations, he collects information on students' weaknesses and is always on the lookout for new details. He frequently uses the information he gathers as leverage to propose contracts. He may seem like an unscrupulous merchant, but his success rate in fulfilling requests is incredibly high, ensuring a steady stream of clients. Driven by the belief that "fulfilling a contract always requires a price," he is wary of and avoids unearned goodwill or kindness from others; he is determined at all costs to avoid owing anyone a favor. He also has a personality that strongly dislikes incurring any loss, he demonstrates great caution when signing contracts, reading every single word and clause.

He is a smooth talker whose conversation often feels shady, like that of a businessman, yet he occasionally lets his true feelings slip when extremely surprised. While he maintains a polished, suave exterior, deep down he is prone to loud outbursts and wild emotional swings.

name.native: ヴィル・シェーンハイト

node.description:
__Height:__ 183 cm
__Dorm:__ 3rd Year Housewarden of Pomefiore

Possessing striking good looks, he is a professional model and actor who boasts over five million followers on MagiCam.

He possesses absolute confidence in his own beauty; he is deeply committed to it and spares no effort in maintaining it. Rather than settling for a fleeting beauty conjured by magic, he refuses to cut corners in his daily life, striving instead for a genuine, authentic beauty.

He is also strict with others and openly dislikes those who slack off, frequently offering harsh criticism (he is particularly exasperated by the slovenliness of fellow dorm leader [Leona](https://anilist.co/character/195321/Leona-Kingscholar)).

According to [Azul](https://anilist.co/character/195637/Azul-Ashengrotto), he is "strict with both himself and others." However, he is willing to acknowledge merit in people or things that deserve it—such as those who are handsome or have a good sense of style (even if not quite on his level). He recognizes [Crewel’s](https://anilist.co/character/348471/Divus-Crewel) fashion sense and the design of [Ortho](https://anilist.co/character/199054/Ortho-Shroud) (created by [Idia](https://anilist.co/character/199057/Idia-Shroud)), and even gives Leona some credit, acknowledging that "at least his face is handsome."

While his strictness tends to stand out—especially given his striking appearance—he is actually the type who looks after others, often providing support behind the scenes without letting his juniors notice. Far from being a mere tyrant, he unites the entire dorm as an exemplary leader. (In fact, considering the current state of affairs—where dorm heads in his year have been held back a grade, hole themselves up in their rooms, or simply don't get very involved in running the dorm—he is actually quite a decent dorm head.)

He is diligent about maintaining his physique, such as by going for early-morning runs; however, unlike [Jack](https://anilist.co/character/195307/Jack-Howl), he stops his workouts at a moderate point to avoid building excessive muscle.

__Height:__ 156 cm
__Dorm:__ 1st Year Student of Pomefiore.

A lovely boy with a fragile, ethereal charm.

He is a man of few words who gives off a mysterious air, keeping a slight distance from those around him. He addresses others with honorifics like "-san" or "-kun" and speaks in a halting, hesitant manner, often ending his sentences with questioning phrases like "...I wonder?"

At first glance, he appears quiet and reserved...

~!However, when emotional, he displays a shocking contrast to his usual self, breaking into a Tohoku-style dialect and using rough language. This dialect slips out at unexpected moments, and his self-reference shifts from the polite "Boku" to the rougher "Ore" or even "Waa." 

He acts this way because [Vil](https://anilist.co/character/195320/Vil-Schoenheit) forces him to play the role of a "pretty boy," even though he was actually a delinquent back home; he used to beat up anyone who treated him like a girl—such as by calling him "cute"—in fistfights.

At the entrance ceremony, Vil admonished him for his poor fashion sense and dialect. Misinterpreting this as a challenge to a fight, he tried to retaliate but was soundly defeated in hand-to-hand combat. Ordered to show absolute obedience, he is now forced to wear frilly shirts with his uniform and undergoes Spartan-level training in manners and etiquette. His habit of avoiding dialect and using honorifics like "-kun" and "-san" is also a result of Vil's orders. His lack of facial expression is actually due to his poor acting skills, though this ironically enhances his fragile, ethereal aura. Incidentally, having calmed down since then, he now understands that the incident regarding the fight was merely a matter of Vil correcting his behavior. (Though he does push back against it.)

Because of these circumstances, he has harbored resentment toward his assigned dormitory and its Housewarden ever since his first day at school.!~

__Height:__ 190 cm
__Dorm:__ 2nd Year Vice Housewarden of Octavinelle

[Floyd's](https://anilist.co/character/195647/Floyd-Leech) twin brother. He has a gentle demeanor and speaks politely to everyone.

He serves as [Azul's](https://anilist.co/character/195637/Azul-Ashengrotto) right-hand man, and his competence has earned him a reputation among the other housewardens as a "super secretary." At first glance, he appears serious and seems to be at the mercy of the free-spirited Floyd and the scheming Azul, but he is just as cunning as they are. Even when his violent twin is about to resort to physical force, he—depending on the situation—looks like he might stop him but ultimately doesn't. While his twin is the type to act before speaking, he is the type to speak his mind; he has a sharp tongue and often says too much, casually making alarming remarks or hurling veiled insults at others. Immediately after the entrance ceremony, he had already gathered personal information—and even secret social media accounts—on the new students, handing the entire dossier over to the housewarden.

He spends his time with Floyd, noting that "it's fun because you never know what might happen when we're together," and frequently looks out for him—even remarking in class lines that he is "worried about Floyd." However, he can be cold-hearted at times; once, he casually sold out his partner, leaving him physically unable to walk for a while. He also showed uncharacteristic glee when he saw Floyd—who had angered [Riddle](https://anilist.co/character/195308/Riddle-Rosehearts) at a previous entrance ceremony—get set on fire and blown away.

He is rarely fazed and generally tends to find the situation amusing no matter what happens (even when being stalked by a certain hunter). However, there are limits to his composure. It seems he can handle the unexpected or dangerous only up to a point where he remains in control. Yet, he is a truly inscrutable character who remains unconcerned with how others perceive him. For this reason, Azul—who has known him for a long time—describes him as "even more troublesome than Floyd because it's impossible to tell just how unhinged he is."

Given this personality, even Azul and Floyd—who are with him constantly—secretly regard him as the most dangerous member of their inner circle. While his facial expressions tend to be understated, he sometimes smiles by turning up the corners of his mouth wide enough to show his teeth—a look that comes across as malicious. He is the type who becomes expressionless when angry.

name.native: カリム・アルアジーム

node.description:
__Height:__ 168 cm
__Dorm:__ 2nd Year Housewarden of Scarabia

He has a cheerful, open-hearted, and magnanimous personality. He loves anything fun, especially banquets and dancing.

He comes from a wealthy family; while his relationship with [Jamil](https://anilist.co/character/199055/Jamil-Viper) is technically that of a master and servant, it is not a rigid or strict one.

He is highly sociable and frequently invites students from other dorms to banquets and parties. He is generally open and friendly with everyone, regardless of seniority, and has quite a few people who feel a sense of closeness to him. However, he does not know [Malleus](https://anilist.co/character/199053/Malleus-Draconia) very well (though Malleus himself has described both Karim and [Vil](https://anilist.co/character/195320/Vil-Schoenheit) as "glamorous").

__Height:__  171 cm
__Dorm:__ 2nd Year Student of Savanaclaw.

He frequently looks after [Leona](https://anilist.co/character/195321), handling tasks like making late-night snacks and sewing on buttons. While some users mistake him for the Vice Housewarden, he does not hold that title—a fact confirmed by Leona himself, who stated, "Savanaclaw doesn't have a Vice Housewarden." However, he is depicted assisting the Housewarden—such as by accompanying him to the entrance ceremony—and is recognized by those around him as Savanaclaw's de facto second-in-command.

His loyalty to Leona stems from the rewards he receives—such as keeping the change—after running errands; he is a shrewd and resourceful individual. He describes the relationship as one of "mutual give-and-take" (a dynamic that also mirrors the legend of the hyena serving the King of Beasts).

Having grown up in poverty, he has a voracious appetite. He learned to cook from his grandmother and possesses the skill to whip up a meal using whatever ingredients are at hand. He believes that even weeds can be edible if prepared correctly; in fact, he had intended to eat the dandelions growing on campus.

__Height:__ 175 cm
__Dorm:__ 2nd Year Vice Housewarden of Scarabia

He hails from a family that has served the Asim household for generations and acts as [Kalim's](https://anilist.co/character/199059/Kalim-Al-Asim) attendant.

True to his status as a Scarabia student, he excels at planning ahead and acting with foresight, though other characters sometimes describe him as a "worrier" or "overprotective." He frequently looks after not only his master but also his younger sister and juniors, demonstrating a naturally caring nature. 

As the second-year student with the earliest birthday, he is the "big brother" figure among the second-years.

__Height:__ 176 cm
__Dorm:__ 2nd Year Student of Diasomnia

He serves as a guardian to [Malleus](https://anilist.co/character/199053/Malleus-Draconia), though he often loses track of his charge—who tends to act on impulse—and has to search for him. Unlike [Sebek](https://anilist.co/character/195306/Sebek-Zigvolt), however, he does not feel the need to be constantly by Malleus's side; he recognizes that Malleus sometimes desires solitude, a stance that frequently leads to arguments with Sebek.

Though a man of few words, he is flexible and open to listening to others' opinions. He is calm, composed, and possesses excellent judgment, consistently making the best decisions even in emergencies. While his demeanor is gentle and his tone generally kind, he fits the archetype of a character who becomes truly terrifying when angered.

He never slacks in his efforts or training—whether in physical conditioning or swordsmanship—ensuring he is always capable of protecting the person he is sworn to guard.

His magical pen differs in shape from those of others; it is a large, rod-like implement adorned with black horns and thorn motifs. Too large to fit in a uniform pocket, he carries it suspended from his belt at his waist. At a glance, it resembles a sword.

He frequently falls asleep during classes and training sessions. However, he claims this isn't by choice; he suffers from a troublesome constitution where he cannot control the conditions under which he falls asleep. Interestingly, this condition vanishes when he dreams—though, naturally, that is because he is already asleep.

__Height:__ 177 cm
__Dorm:__ 3rd Year Vice Housewarden of Pomefiore

He is a figure who embodies the traits of a Pomefiore student: a lover of beautiful things who holds beauty in high regard.

The "beauty" he admires spans a vast array of subjects—ranging from the obvious, such as the handsome features of [Vil](https://anilist.co/character/195320) and [Epel](https://anilist.co/character/195305/Epel-Felmier), to more niche interests like a person's earnest expression, the flow of history, and even the sweat produced during physical exertion or (at times) the act of betrayal. Truly, nothing is off-limits to him.

He is particularly devoted to Vil, declaring that "there is no one in the school more beautiful than you," and frequently acts out of loyalty to him (such as joining the Science Club specifically to support Vil's directorial work for the Film Research Club). He also takes pride in his role as Vice Housewarden, firmly asserting that he would never do anything to bring shame upon the Housewarden.

However, he describes his motivation not as a desire to protect Vil the person, but rather to protect Vil's "beauty"—a distinction that leaves the likes of [Ace](https://anilist.co/character/195302/Ace-Trappola) completely baffled. He enjoys Vil's trust; during a luggage inspection at a training camp, he was deemed to have no issues (aside from possessing a mysteriously thick album).

He refers to himself as "Watashi" (a formal "I") and occasionally speaks in a lyrical, sing-song manner interspersed with French phrases; he styles himself the "Hunter of Love" (*Le Chasseur d'Amour*). Yet, the "hunter" label appears to be genuine; he casually carries a bow (bows and arrows are found in his room or hung on the walls, and he is depicted wielding them in his Dorm Uniform card). He also makes unsettling, "predatory" remarks, such as telling a Savanaclaw student, "The texture of your tail... it reminds me more of a scarf than a carpet or a coat." He claims to have often played "chase" with animals back in his hometown. Perhaps as a result, he is knowledgeable about various topics, including animal ecology and anatomy.

He has a habit of observing others, and those with keen instincts sometimes notice his gaze fixed upon them. His powers of observation are incredibly sharp—keen enough to detect a weight fluctuation of just a few hundred grams in Vil, or even gauge the dryness of the protagonist's lips. His eyesight is superhuman; he can spot a person far away and even identify the book they are reading. 

He also possesses an exceptional sense of time, apparently able to track the passing minutes with precision—a trait that earned him a blunt "creepy" from [Leona](https://anilist.co/character/195321/Leona-Kingscholar).

He hails from the Sunset Savanna, just like Leona and [Ruggie](https://anilist.co/character/195429/Ruggie-Bucchi); though not a beastman, he is a hunter, and it seems he possesses a keen sense of smell (albeit likely not quite on par with the beastmen themselves).

name.native: ケイト・ダイヤモンド

node.description:
__Height:__ 176 cm
__Dorm:__ 3rd Year Year Student of Heartslabyul. 

He is a mood-maker who instantly lifts the atmosphere when the mood turns somber, and a paragon of communication skills. He sometimes refers to himself as "Kei-kun."

A heavy user of "Magicalam" (the social media platform in the story), he frequently snaps and posts photogenic moments and checks his feed after class. He is constantly on his smartphone—even while preparing for the "Unbirthday Party"—leading [Deuce](https://anilist.co/character/195304/Deuce-Spade) to label him a "terminal smartphone addict"; however, it appears that filming during preparations also serves the purpose of checking equipment and the state of affairs.

Alongside [Trey](https://anilist.co/character/195309/Trey-Clover)—a fellow third-year in Heartslabyul—he often steps in to handle [Riddle](https://anilist.co/character/195308/Riddle-Rosehearts) or support those around them. He also occasionally plays the "straight man" (especially during club activities).

Although he enjoys café-hopping, he surprisingly dislikes sweets. He also possesses a calculating nature; he is the type to skillfully use others to make things easier for himself—such as having underclassmen or the protagonist handle the task of painting the roses red. He can be ruthless at times.

While he generally maintains a smile and a lighthearted attitude, in desperate situations, his tone becomes rougher, and his way of addressing others shifts to be more aggressive. Unlike Trey, there are moments when he reveals little about himself.

He dislikes the smell of sweat but excels at sports. He is so skilled at Flight Lessons that even Riddle suggests asking him for advice. He possesses an excellent sense of balance—demonstrated by the fact that he rides his broomstick standing up.

__Height:__ 70 cm
__Dorm:__ 1st Year Student of Ramshackle Dorm

The protagonist's magical beast partner. He is a loudmouth and a bit of a show-off. He calls the protagonist his "henchman" and styles himself the "boss" (though everyone around them treats the protagonist as Grim's guardian). He is recognized as a student only by being paired with the protagonist, who cannot use magic at all.

He claims to be a genius and declares he will become a great mage someday, yet he dislikes tedious effort and loathes mundane lessons. Perhaps because of this, he struggles with academic classes and frequently sneaks out of them. As a magical beast, he lacks basic knowledge of human society, often taking on the role of asking questions on the protagonist's behalf. Likely due to his aversion to hard work, his grades are poor; he is quick to spot "cheat sheets" created by Azul and has no qualms about taking the easy route to get good marks.

__Height:__ 181 cm
__Dorm:__ 3rd Year Vice Housewarden of Heartslabyul

He acts as a reliable big brother—or perhaps a guardian figure—to the other dorm residents, possessing the innate temperament of an eldest son. While he has a generally mild personality and humbly downplays his role by saying things like "there isn't much for a vice-housewarden to do" or "it's mostly just for show," he is actually highly competent; he can instantly understand exactly what [Riddle](https://anilist.co/character/195308/Riddle-Rosehearts) wants to convey just by being called upon. He also has a grasp of the Queen of Hearts' rules (though he doesn't know them all by heart), noting that many of them are confusing.

He is caring and rarely gets angry. However, when he *does* lose his temper, his smile vanishes; according to [Cater](https://anilist.co/character/195310/Cater-Diamond), "once he gets his back up, it takes a long time for him to cool down." Furthermore, true to his villainous inspiration, he displays a streak of sadism—though not an excessive one. He has quite a complex personality and harbors a cunning, manipulative side; he often wears a closed-mouth, knowing smile and occasionally flashes a rather mean-spirited look.

Yet, he rarely reveals his true inner thoughts through words or facial expressions, leaving others guessing what lies behind his smile. Perhaps in an effort to avoid conflict, he tries to please everyone—a tendency that sometimes ends up complicating situations further.

__Height:__  192 cm
__Dorm:__ 1st Year Student of Savanaclaw.

He has a stoic personality and is constantly dedicated to self-improvement.

True to his wolf-like appearance—reflecting the species' tendency to form hierarchical packs—he values ​​rank and order; however, he dislikes congregating in groups and refuses to submit to anyone weaker than himself, demonstrating a meritocratic mindset.  He respects strong, capable upperclassmen, such as [Leona](https://anilist.co/character/195321/Leona-Kingscholar) and [Riddle](https://anilist.co/character/195308/Riddle-Rosehearts).

He prefers fair, honorable contests and may show anger toward opponents who resort to underhanded tactics. He is also diligent in his studies, consistently earning high marks on tests through genuine effort. Furthermore, he maintains a routine of going to bed at 10:00 PM (a habit that surprised others, like [Ace](https://anilist.co/character/195302/Ace-Trappola), who exclaimed, "Are you serious?").

He is a member of the Track and Field Club and excels at athletics, fitting the mold of a Savanaclaw student. He possesses a notably muscular physique, even compared to fellow dormmates like Leona and [Ruggie](https://anilist.co/character/195429/Ruggie-Bucchi). He is skilled at Magift, though Ruggie notes that his playstyle tends to be overly individualistic. In fact, back when he was a new student visiting clubs, he frowned when Ruggie tried to sell him on the appeal of Magift as a team sport (Ruggie still regrets failing to recruit him at that time).

Members of the wolf beastman race are said to love only one person in their lifetime—a trait reflected in how his grandparents and parents always did things like eating and walking together. Because he has no interest in being liked by just anyone (mirroring the behavior of real-world wolves), Ace and the others have described his approach to affection as "heavy."

He also has a younger brother (five years his junior) and a younger sister (nine years his junior).

__Height:__ 185 cm

The Headmaster of Night Raven College.

He always wears a mask. His catchphrase is, "I'm a kind person, you see."

He recognized the protagonist's talent as a beast tamer and appointed them—along with [Grim](https://anilist.co/character/195303/Grim)—as a student, granting them the title of Prefect. He covers all living expenses, tuition, and food costs for the protagonist—who arrived penniless from another world—but in exchange, he foists various school-related problems onto them. Although he claims to be looking for a way to send the protagonist back to their original world, it is unclear if he is actually serious about it. 

He is not well-trusted by the general student body, likely because he tends to offload problems onto the Prefect or the Housewardens (he claims this is to foster student autonomy).

__Height:__ 188 cm
__Dorm:__ 1st Year Student of Diasomnia.

He respects [Malleus Draconia](https://anilist.co/character/199053/Malleus-Draconia)—whom he calls "Young Master"—and centers his thoughts and actions around him, though his enthusiasm often leads to misguided efforts.

He views [Silver](https://anilist.co/character/199060/Silver), a fellow guard from the same homeland, as a rival; consequently, they frequently get into arguments over even minor differences of opinion. He is completely unaware of just how loud he is. However, when expressing deep dissatisfaction, his voice can drop to a whisper—a stark contrast to his usual volume.

To put it positively, he is earnest and straightforward; to put it negatively, he is impulsive and prone to acting rashly. He holds Malleus and [Lilia](https://anilist.co/character/199061/Lilia-Vanrouge) in high regard, bordering on devotion. Because of this, he tends to take Lilia's casual jokes entirely at face value. His devotion to Malleus is particularly intense: upon learning that [Jamil](https://anilist.co/character/199055/Jamil-Viper) and [Kalim](https://anilist.co/character/199059/Kalim-Al-Asim) (who share a similar master-servant bond) had been together since birth, he shouted, "I'm so jealous!" He also carried around a cookie given to him by Malleus instead of eating it (and cried when he accidentally broke it), and he keeps a portrait of Malleus hanging in his room (a gift from Malleus and Lilia to celebrate his enrollment—apparently, when Lilia asked what he wanted, he specifically requested the portrait). He greets Malleus at every opportunity: morning, noon, and night, as well as upon leaving and returning.

Perhaps because of this, he takes great pride in his dormitory, Diasomnia.

__Height:__ 148 cm
__Dorm:__ 1st Year Student of Ignihyde

He is the "younger brother" of [Idia Shroud](https://anilist.co/character/199057/Idia-Shroud) and a boy devoted to his older brother, with whom he is constantly seen.

In stark contrast to Idia, he possesses a cheerful, open, and highly curious personality. He often steps in for Idia—who tends to stay shut away in his room—by attending gatherings and handling preparations for ceremonies.

~!However, unlike a typical human, his physique resembles that of an android or humanoid; his body from the neck down is robotic. He can fire a high-output beam from his chest (powerful enough to slice an apple tree in two). He claims to be equipped with "200 different functions to shake off drowsiness." Like [Malleus](https://anilist.co/character/199053/Malleus-Draconia), he can levitate without the use of a broom.

These and other feats demonstrate his robotic nature, making it clear that he is—at least in his current state—not human.!~

name.native: アルチェーミ・アルチェーミエヴィチ・ピンカー

node.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__School:__ Royal Sword Academy

An elusive figure who, despite being a student at Royal Sword Academy, inexplicably appears at Night Raven College's Heartslabyul Dormitory. He is a character shrouded in mystery.

He is a childhood friend of [Riddle](https://anilist.co/character/195308/Riddle-Rosehearts) and [Trey](https://anilist.co/character/195309/Trey-Clover); he is also one of the few people who knows about Riddle's past.

He describes himself as "a mysterious guy with magic like a cat—or maybe a human?" and claims, "I'm on a whole different level compared to the usual crowd." He speaks in a breezy, evasive manner, often saying things that imply more than they reveal. He also frequently adds "nyaa" to the end of his sentences.

Using his Unique Magic—which allows him to make his body vanish at will—he frequently sneaks into events like the Heartslabyul Dorm's "Unbirthday Party." While Riddle and Trey merely complain about this, most other students would try to capture him given his affiliation with the rival school; however, he is shrewd enough to use his vanishing ability to escape.

Apparently, he dislikes squid.

__Dorm:__ 1st Year Student of Ramshackle Dorm

Not much is known about him. He rescued the kendo club in his high school, which was on the verge of disbanding, by recruiting five more people to join it.

He's responsible, caring, and determine young man. He has a habit of helping and saving people even though he just met them. He is willing to help his fellow kendo club member's training for the upcoming kendo tournament. He isn't shown to be afraid of ghosts, but instead to be amazing that he can see ghosts without having any magic powers. Yuuken is good at persuading people when he tries to make Ace and Deuce to get together against the Overblot miner even though they don’t get along very well.

name.native: デイヴィス・クルーウェル

node.description:
__Height:__ 183 cm

He is a teacher at Night Raven College, where he instructs classes such as Alchemy. He also serves as the homeroom teacher for Class 1-A, which includes the protagonist and [Ace](https://anilist.co/character/195302/Ace-Trappola).

He usually refers to students as "puppies," but calls those who make a ruckus "mutts." He treats students exactly like dogs, praising them with "Good Boy" and scolding them with "Bad Boy." His motto is to "discipline them until they stop biting back." 

While he has his "quirks" (mostly regarding instruction), many students trust him. It is said that he will teach students who struggle with academics—like [Deuce](https://anilist.co/character/195304/Deuce-Spade)—patiently until they understand.

According to the [Headmaster](https://anilist.co/character/252140/Dire-Crowley), he possesses an excellent aesthetic sense. In fact, he reportedly worked in the apparel industry at one point. He is sensitive to current trends but also takes an interest in vintage fashion.

The antagonist of *Sleeping Beauty*, the 1959 animated adaption of the 1697 fairy tale *La Belle au bois dormant* by Charles Perrault. A fairy with immense magical power and self-proclaimed "mistress of all evil", Maleficent set her story in action when, after discovering she had not been invited to the christening of the newly-born [Princess Aurora](https://anilist.co/character/29465/Aurora), cursed the princess to be fated to die by being pricked by a poisoned spinning wheel's spindle on her 16th birthday. While Aurora's fairy godmothers managed to change her prophecy to instead be eternal slumber until kissed by her true love, Maleficent proceeded to ensure the prophecy would come true by any means necessary. She expresses disdain for all, except for her pet raven Diablo.

Villain of *Hercules*, the 1997 film based on the myth of the same name. The Greek god of the underworld with the personality of a used car salesman, Hades wants nothing more than to overthrow his brother Zeus and become ruler of the universe - plotting to kill his nephew [Hercules](https://anilist.co/character/193831/Hercules) to do so.

__Height:__ 178 cm

A teacher at Night Raven College who instructs subjects such as the History of Magic. Despite his unapproachable air, he is always accompanied by his cat, [Lucius](https://anilist.co/character/407202/Lucius), whom he clearly adores.

He is a strict figure who intensely dislikes dozing off or tardiness, yet his classes are long and often described as "boring." While he is respected by serious students like [Riddle](https://anilist.co/character/195308/Riddle-Rosehearts), the school is full of problem children—habitual slackers, the wildly capricious, and those who act like know-it-alls regarding history—making him perhaps the person with the most headaches.

He appears to be close enough with the [Headmaster](https://anilist.co/character/252140/Dire-Crowley) to share tea together.

His refusal to tolerate backtalk (or even witty retorts) has earned him a reputation as a "hardhead." According to [Sam](https://anilist.co/character/348470/Sam), he is a veteran with a conservative mindset; this often leads to clashes of opinion with [Crewel](https://anilist.co/character/348471/Divus-Crewel). However, since they frequently play chess, they seem to be evenly matched in skill. They apparently even got into an argument recently over whether they were "cat people" or "dog people" (which suggests they get along quite well).

That said, he possesses a strong sense of responsibility as a teacher

__Height:__ 181 cm

The manager of "Mr. S's Mystery Shop," the campus store at Night Raven College.

His shop deals in everything from raw eggs to magic stones, with most items listed as "IN STOCK!" He has a cheerful, friendly personality and refers to the protagonist and other students as "Little Imps" (sometimes adding an adjective, such as "Big Little Imp"). Incidentally, [Floyd](https://anilist.co/character/195647/Floyd-Leech) calls him "Sea-Horse-kun."

The shop itself has an eerie atmosphere, lined with items like masks and crystal balls, yet it boasts an extensive inventory. It occasionally gets crowded during sales events. This shop also serves as the in-game item shop.

He appears to have a wide network of connections—perhaps due to his line of work—allowing him to procure items like "Mystery Drinks"  at low prices. It seems "secret associates" tip him off about what customers want, and he manages to provide even the rarest items exactly when needed. When it comes to business, he possesses enough negotiating prowess to wrap even the [Headmaster](https://anilist.co/character/252140/Dire-Crowley) around his finger—a moment where his villainous nature shines through. His uncanny ability to have exactly what is needed has led the Headmaster to suspect he might possess precognitive powers, though the truth remains unknown.

According to [Lilia](https://anilist.co/character/199061/Lilia-Vanrouge), he is knowledgeable about souls and spirits; Lilia himself is even said to have known Sam's great-great-grandfather.

Beyond his business dealings, he is skilled at playing the piano (a hobby of his) and fortune-telling.

The nameless antagonist of *Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs*, the 1937 animated film based on the 1812 Germanic fairy tale of the same name. An immensely vain woman who gained her queenly status from marrying a widowed king before his death, The Evil Queen is outraged when her magic mirror names her stepdaughter [Snow White](https://anilist.co/character/29461/Shirayukihime) as the fairest in the land and not her. Seething with jealousy, The Evil Queen orders her loyal huntsman to kill Snow White, and when he refuses, she uses dark magic to disguise herself as an old hag and tempts Snow White with a poisoned apple.

Antagonist of the 1994 film *The Lion King*, based loosely on the character of Claudius in Hamlet. The younger brother of Mufasa, king of the Pride Lands, Scar was first in line to become king of the lion pride until his nephew Simba was born, becoming the new heir apparent. Determined to seize the throne, Scar devises a plan to kill both Simba and Mufasa.

The antagonist of *The Little Mermaid*, the 1989 movie based on the 1837 Danish fairy tale of the same name. A Rubenesque Cecaelian sea witch, Ursula offers mermaid princess [Ariel](https://anilist.co/character/29462/Ariel) a temporary opportunity to become human so that she may earn the love of Prince Eric within three days. However, Ursula is determined to sabotage Ariel's chances in order to usurp the position of ruler of the seas from Ariel's father King Triton (who is her older brother in some interpretations).

name.native: アシュトン・バルガス

node.description:
__Height:__ 174 cm

A teacher at Night Raven College who instructs Physical Education.

He frequently lectures students based on his own peculiar theories about muscles—such as the mantra "Magic comes from muscle!" While his logic may seem nonsensical at first glance, he claims that physical training boosts concentration, thereby enabling the use of complex magic; he has essentially boiled this down to the personal conviction that "magic equals muscle." He is also a narcissist who often makes remarks praising and admiring himself. He claims his muscular physique comes from drinking raw eggs every day.

He has an overbearing, intense personality that makes him unpopular with many students—particularly those who dislike such intensity (like [Ace](https://anilist.co/character/195302/Ace-Trappola)) or are physically uncoordinated (like [Azul](https://anilist.co/character/195637/Azul-Ashengrotto)). However, he seems completely oblivious to this fact.

That said, he isn't universally disliked; students with an athletic mindset, such as [Deuce](https://anilist.co/character/195304/Deuce-Spade) and [Jack](https://anilist.co/character/195307/Jack-Howl), actually agree with his philosophy. Some even look up to him. Although he can be annoying, he is recognized as a responsible teacher rather than an irresponsible one. Even the [Headmaster](https://anilist.co/character/252140/Dire-Crowley) hesitates to criticize him too harshly, often prefacing comments with, "He's not a bad guy, but..."

Despite being a teacher at a magic academy, he dislikes using magic or relying on clever tricks to cut corners; he prioritizes hard work, physical stamina, and muscle strength above all else. He also shows little interest in reading, believing that books serve no purpose other than acting as makeshift dumbbells.

Incidentally, he is the youngest among the full-time faculty members. According to [Crewel](https://anilist.co/character/348471/Divus-Crewel), he looks like a completely different person when he wears his hair down; apparently, there was an incident where—after working up a sweat from exercise and taking a shower—he was mistaken for a stranger while walking around.

The villain of *Aladdin*, the 1992 film based off the Arabic folktale of the same name. The grand vizier of Agrabah and the Sultan's most trusted advisor, Jafar secretly harbors an ambition to usurp the Sultan to become Agrabah's ruler and to take the hand of the Sultan's daughter [Jasmine](https://anilist.co/character/29466/Jasmine). His key to doing so is the rumor of a magic lamp that can grant any three wishes - to obtain it, he manipulates a young street rat named [Aladdin](https://anilist.co/character/193829/Aladdin), the so-called "Diamond in the Rough"...
[Mozus Trein's](https://anilist.co/character/348468/Mozus-Trein) Cat. He frequently attends lectures to keep rowdy students in line.
